title: fs019第一辆魔法版本摩托车上fs020第一辆魔法版本摩托车下

第九章 爱未散，思终起，义难全（下）
第二日，未等待灰矮人部落的到来，文森已然按耐不住想要先挖掘一些绝魔金属。魔法版本的摩托车，想想都觉得激动不已！
当初魔武世界中，便有牛人提出这个设计方案。奈何制造魔法版本的摩托车，需要炼金、魔纹、锻造三位一体，并且职业等级超高。
否则，根本不可能将两个原本不相溶的体系，融汇在一起！
“小黑，我们走！”文森站在二楼阳台，踏着暗黑魔龙达克斯伸过来的翅膀，走到他背上。
“无所不能伟大的主人，我们去哪里？”
暗黑魔龙完全抛弃了龙族的高贵理念，将马屁拍的啪啪响。丝毫没有一丝不好意思的表现，完全是融入了恶仆的角色之中。
文森指着荒山山脉中央，那座最大的高山，“去山顶！”
暗黑魔龙翅膀轻煽，一眨眼功夫，已经飞在半空之中。距离那半山别墅，少说有二十飞轮以上距离！
传说巅峰级的威能，无时无刻不显露！
所谓望山跑死马，可这对暗黑魔龙显然不适用。仅仅五分钟不到，暗黑魔龙载着文森降落在蕴含在魔晶矿脉的山顶。
魔晶矿脉山的山巅如同一个平台，文森看着坚实的地面，有些挠头。
绝魔金属从广泛意义上来讲，能够有效的阻隔魔力、斗气。强行使用魔力、斗气挖掘，最好的结果也就是让绝魔金属破碎分解。因此，挖掘绝魔金属不能使用魔法或者斗气取巧，只能使用肉体的力量，靠蛮力挖掘。
文森目前只是上位高级魔法师，任凭他用魔法狂轰滥炸，估计最多能把绝魔金属炸烂，而不能安稳挖掘出绝魔金属。
这个时候，又该小弟暗黑魔龙出场啦！
“小黑，挖土！从这里挖，一直向下挖！只能用爪子挖，不能用魔法！”
暗黑魔龙一阵头晕，居然叫一头高贵的黑龙来挖土？
他可不是该死的地精，也不是讨厌的灰矮人！
不过，摄于文森乃是他的主人，暗黑魔龙心中悲戚，抬起爪子刨地。
传说巅峰级的实力，即使只用肉体力量，也是强横无匹的！

没刨多久，地面便出现一个深达十多米的深坑。暗黑魔龙仿佛不知疲倦的机器，爪子、翅膀皆用上，不停地将泥土向后高高抛起。
“叮~！”
一声金属碰撞的声音响起，暗黑魔龙从深坑中退了出来，莽声莽气道：“主人，下面发现了银白色的金属层。”
文森心中大喜，绝魔金属正是银白色！
“小黑，你小心的将那银白色金属挖一点出来。不要使用魔法力量，只用爪子小心抓一点出来。”文森吩咐道。
“遵命，我伟大的主人！”达克斯右前爪按在银白色的绝魔金属上，缓缓用力。
锋利的爪子刺入绝魔金属中，然后爪子一缩，西瓜大小的一块银白色金属掉落下来。暗黑魔龙抓了出来，献媚的递给文森。
“伟大的主人，这个银白色的金属是什么？我怎么感觉到它在影响我的魔力。”传说巅峰级的暗黑魔龙，对魔力的细微变化感觉十分清晰。
文森将绝魔金属收入无尽之空后，踏上暗黑魔龙的后背，才道：“这叫绝魔金属，在炼金领域有极重要的作用。不过由于它的产量稀少，所以名声不显。”
“绝魔金属？魔晶大炮！”暗黑魔龙有些惊讶的问道。
文森有些诧异，暗黑魔龙见识不凡呐！
“小黑，你倒是有些见识！”文森夸了一句。
回到半山别墅后，文森一头钻进四楼，魔法别墅的四楼，正是一间实验室。
四楼中，文森摆弄着各种仪器，银白色的绝魔金属被特殊的魔法阵虚空托住，然后就在虚空中煅烧，熔炼。
文森不停从无尽之空中取出各种各样的魔法金属，准备手工打造一台魔法版本的摩托车。
首先需要制作的是一个摩托车整体构架，这部分工作，需要锻造职业辅助。所幸，锻造物品，并非真的需要开炉生火，一锤一锤的敲打。
大师等级以上的生活职业，均有神炼术。除了一些不适合用神炼术的材料之外，神炼术还是极为方便的。
摩托车的整体构架，一定要坚固，文森选择了冰原寒铁。这种魔法材料不但具备坚硬的材质，还有良好的韧性，并且不是什么稀有的魔法材料，冰原覆盖地区的铁矿会自然伴生。
文森根据科技世界中的摩托车外形，用锻造神炼术将冰原寒铁快速的塑造出摩托车的整体构架。
当然了，只是外形相似，内在的机械结构肯定有所不同。毕竟一个是科技体系的产物，一个是魔法体系的产物。

魔法体系的动力能源比不得科技体系的复杂，能够依靠魔晶，轻易的获取动力。制造完成整体构架后，文森考虑了一下如何控制魔法版本摩托车的速度问题。
参考了科技体系中的换挡拨片，文森在摩托车两个把手内侧，设计了两个拨片，方便左右手握住把手时，大拇指按动。
按住右边的拨片，开始能量输出，速度提升，反之取消能量输出，动力下降，并且制动系统启动，降低速度。
制作轮胎的时候，可把他难住了！
克伦蒂亚世界中虽然也有橡胶，不过显然不合适。克伦蒂亚世界中不但个人力量强横异常，自然界中的生物也是强横异常，如果用橡胶做轮胎，保不准就被什么魔兽咬穿或者被某种植物扎透。
最后，文森只得采用炼金术，结合魔纹技术，将赤炎魔铁制成如同橡胶一般的记忆柔软金属，内圈依旧采用冰原寒铁。
不过，如此一来，两只轮胎的造价剧增！
特别是魔纹技术中的记忆魔纹阵图、软化魔纹阵图，这两个阵图，非是宗师级往上的魔纹师不能制作。
文森苦笑，两只轮胎的成本，竟然比整体车身还要高！
在实验室中忙忙碌碌了七八天，整个魔法版本摩托车基本制造完成。除了最关键的发动机部分。

Chapter 9: Love is not gone, thoughts come to an end, and righteousness is difficult to fulfill (Part 2)
On the second day, before waiting for the arrival of the gray dwarf tribe, Vincent couldn't help but want to dig some magic metal first. Thinking about this magical version of a motorcycle makes me excited!
In the world of magic and martial arts, some talented people proposed this design plan. How to make a magic version of a motorcycle requires the trinity of alchemy, magic patterns, and forging, as well as a very high professional level.
Otherwise, it would be impossible to merge two originally incompatible systems together!
"Xiao Hei, let's go!" Vincent stood on the second floor balcony, walking on the wings stretched out by the dark dragon Dax, and walked onto his back.
"Omnipotent and great master, where are we going?"
The Dark Demonic Dragon completely abandoned the noble ideals of the dragon clan and flattered everyone. There was no hint of embarrassment at all, and he completely blended into the role of the evil servant.
Vincent pointed to the largest mountain in the middle of the Barren Mountains, "Go to the top of the mountain!"
The dark dragon flapped its wings lightly, and in the blink of an eye, it was already flying in mid-air. It is at least twenty flywheels away from the mountain villa!
The power of the legendary peak level is revealed at all times!
The so-called Wangshan is a dead horse, but this obviously does not apply to the Dark Dragon. In less than five minutes, the dark dragon carried Vincent to the top of the mountain containing the magic crystal veins.
The top of the Magic Crystal Mine Mountain was like a platform. Vincent looked at the solid ground and scratched his head.
In a broad sense, the magic metal can effectively block magic and fighting spirit. Forcibly using magic power and fighting spirit to dig, the best result is to break the magic metal and decompose it. Therefore, you cannot use magic or fighting spirit to dig out the magic metal. You can only use physical strength and brute force to dig.
Vincent is currently only a high-ranking high-level magician. No matter how much he bombards with magic, he will probably be able to blow up the Absolute Demon Metal to pieces at most, but he will not be able to dig out the Absolute Demon Metal safely.
At this time, it’s time for the little brother Dark Dragon to appear again!
"Xiao Hei, dig in the soil! Dig from here, all the way down! You can only dig with your claws, not magic!"
The Dark Demonic Dragon felt dizzy and actually asked a noble black dragon to dig the soil?
He is not a damn goblin, nor is he a nasty duergar!
However, Yu Wensen was his master. The dark dragon felt sad and raised its claws to dig at the ground.
Legend has it that the peak level of strength is unparalleled even if it only uses physical strength!
Not long after digging, a deep pit more than ten meters deep appeared on the ground. The Dark Demonic Dragon was like a tireless machine, using its claws and wings to constantly throw the dirt back high.
"Ding~!"
There was a sound of metal colliding, and the Dark Demonic Dragon retreated from the pit and said in a rude voice: "Master, a silver-white metal layer was found below."
Vincent was overjoyed, the magic metal was silver-white!
"Xiao Hei, carefully dig out a little bit of the silver-white metal. Don't use magic power, just use your claws to carefully grab a little bit out." Vincent ordered.
"As you command, my great master!" Dax pressed his right front paw on the silver-white magic metal and slowly exerted force.
The sharp claws pierced into the magic metal, then retracted the claws, and a piece of silver-white metal the size of a watermelon fell down. The dark dragon grabbed it out and handed it to Vincent flatteringly.
"Great Master, what is this silver-white metal? Why do I feel that it is affecting my magic power." The legendary peak-level dark dragon can feel the subtle changes in magic power very clearly.
After Vincent put the Absolute Demonic Metal into the Endless Sky, he stepped on the back of the Dark Demon Dragon and said, "This is called Absolute Demonic Metal, and it plays an extremely important role in the field of alchemy. However, due to its rare production, its reputation is not obvious."
"Ultimate magic metal? Magic crystal cannon!" the dark dragon asked in surprise.
Vincent was a little surprised, the Dark Dragon had extraordinary knowledge!
"Xiao Hei,You do have some knowledge! " Vincent praised.
After returning to the Mid-level Villa, Vincent dove into the fourth floor. The fourth floor of the Magic Villa was a laboratory.
On the fourth floor, Vincent was playing with various instruments. The silver-white magic metal was held in the void by a special magic circle, and then calcined and smelted in the void.
Vincent kept taking out various magic metals from the endless sky, preparing to hand-build a magic version of the motorcycle.
The first thing that needs to be made is an overall motorcycle structure. This part of the work requires the assistance of a forging professional. Fortunately, forging an item does not really require lighting a fire and hammering it with hammer after hammer.
All life professions above the master level have divine refining techniques. Except for some materials that are not suitable for divine refining, divine refining is still extremely convenient.
The overall structure of the motorcycle must be strong, and Vincent chose Icefield Cold Iron. This magic material is not only hard, but also has good toughness. It is not a rare magic material and is naturally associated with iron ore in areas covered by ice sheets.
Based on the appearance of motorcycles in the technological world, Vincent used the forging technique to quickly shape the entire structure of the motorcycle from the cold iron of the ice field.
Of course, although the appearance is similar, the internal mechanical structure must be different. After all, one is the product of the technological system and the other is the product of the magic system.
The power source of the magic system is not as complex as the technology system, and it can easily obtain power by relying on magic crystals. After completing the overall structure, Vincent thought about how to control the speed of the magic version of the motorcycle.
Referring to the shift paddles in the technology system, Vincent designed two paddles on the inside of the two handles of the motorcycle to facilitate the thumbs of the left and right hands to press when holding the handles.
Press and hold the paddle on the right to start energy output and increase the speed. Otherwise, cancel the energy output, the power decreases, and the braking system starts to reduce the speed.
When making tires, he was stumped!
Although there is rubber in the world of Crentia, it is obviously inappropriate. In the world of Crentia, not only are individuals extremely powerful, but the creatures in nature are also extremely powerful. If you use rubber as a tire, you are guaranteed to be bitten by some monster or pierced by some kind of plant.
In the end, Vincent had no choice but to use alchemy, combined with magic pattern technology, to make the red flame magic iron into a rubber-like memory soft metal, and the inner ring was still made of ice field cold iron.
However, as a result, the cost of the two tires increased dramatically!
Especially the memory magic pattern array and the softening magic pattern array in the magic pattern technology. These two arrays cannot be produced by magic pattern masters who are not at the master level.
Vincent smiled bitterly, the cost of two tires was actually higher than the entire body!
After seven or eight days of busy work in the laboratory, the entire magic version of the motorcycle was basically completed. Except for the most critical engine part.
